review_findings: All public model access from views is immutable; mutating typed actions route through Provider.execute.
Error paths publish no candidate; checked counters cannot wrap.
Snapshot slices and lengths/counts checked before string/history allocations; history/text/global size bounds explicit.
Duplicate records and per-caller high-water survive view recreation and same-provider restore; new-provider dedup transfer is unsupported.
Context registration/control-plane is host-trusted, not a same-process security boundary.
Unicode dependency is cached/pinned, no std, build script or transitive runtime dependency; notices/inventory updated.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Shared versioned executor and adapter parity
acceptance_criteria.evidence: replay-result.json: four entries each replay all 21 operations; equal outcomes/state/checkpoint hashes

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Unsaved state survives view recreation and snapshot roundtrip
acceptance_criteria.evidence: replay-result.json, independent-codec.json, traces/tests.txt: text, selection, undo/redo, dirty, preferences/session retained
56 negative entry/case pairs plus retry eviction/mismatch, Unicode/context/authority unit tests

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Snapshot bounds/version failures preserve active state; explicit fields
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 17 model tests, independent initial hex/final PowerShell decoding; no raw layout or toolkit objects
Contract/runbook/story explicitly defer provider replacement, kernel authority and M3/M5 enforcement

reviewer: Codex local self-review; not independent approval
limits: No actual toolkit widgets, input routing, rendering or native accessibility consumer.
No guest linkage/execution, live guest reload, isolation or IPC.
No provider replacement, durable state, save/filesystem operation or authenticated checkpoint.
No shaping/bidi/font conformance or measured host/guest performance; 256 MiB guest target unchanged.
